note: v1 85.029 on seed 0, 85.179 on seed 11: Window Seat, night-bus 2-step (147 s, 136 bpm, F# minor). note: v2, written: THE CHAIN and THE RESAMPLE. In the last groove the chops leave their three-note cell and become a dotted-eighth chain - a syllable every three sixteenths (la / mo / ye cycling over the chord's 9th, 5th and 3rd, an octave up), running across the bar lines against the 2-step, so the voice carries the garage cross-rhythm into the climax (measured: the renders part 84.7-134.8 s). And the half-bar before THE STOP and before the breakdown is grabbed and stuttered on the master in dotted-eighth slices (3/16 x 3, decaying), the resample gesture Harry liked on t4, at the seams where it marks a turn rather than cutting a new section (renders part at 41.5 and 69.7 s).
